experiment: Phase 3 (strict Lean) + Phase 4 (falsification feedback) + 5-iteration learning loop
headline: Hyperloop external Odlyzko mean is REPRODUCIBLY +0.1807 above klein and +0.1344 above baseline across all 5 iterations. Hyperloop's intra-campaign Odlyzko score also RISES from r1=0.440 to r5-r10=0.520-0.620 — real learning that the contradiction-count metric I initially used to gate termination missed.
honest_findings: 5/5 iterations produced IDENTICAL results — apparatus is fully deterministic given seed packs and topology mode. Reproducibility verified.
Hyperloop external lift over klein is stable +0.1807 — much larger than the noise floor and reproducible.

The contradiction-count metric I used as the loop's early-termination signal is the WRONG metric. Hyperloop's per-candidate contradiction count stays flat at ~3 across rounds (no reduction), but its mean Odlyzko score RISES because the ledger redirects family selection toward more-confirming mixes.
Klein topology DRIFTS DOWN over rounds (r1=0.275 → r10=0.338 with peak at r2=0.450 then decline). Same campaign budget, hyperloop improves while klein degrades.
Phase 4 ledger DOES produce learning, just not contradiction-count reduction. The learning manifests as confirmation-rate improvement instead.
what_remains_dishonest: Auto-generated lean skeletons remain sorry-filled. Phase 3 strict audit shows 1/10 strict-pass. The apparatus produces verifiable structure, not proofs.
Hyperloop's lift is partly because it generates FEWER candidates (overload filter), not better ones. Per-candidate accuracy is similar to klein.
Claim windows are derived from a hand-picked family-preferred-height table, not from actual mathematical reasoning the candidate performed.
All this happens on a 10-round campaign with 8 hypotheses/round. None of these are proofs of RH or even partial steps toward one.
